receipt_hash_revision.name: receipt_hash_revision
receipt_hash_revision.value: "command_receipts"."request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND ("command_receipts"."resulting_revision" IS NULL OR "command_receipts"."resulting_revision" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

daily_attempts_check1.name: daily_attempts_check1
daily_attempts_check1.value: ("daily_attempts"."status"='LOSS' AND "daily_attempts"."retry_available_at"="daily_attempts"."ended_at"+interval '1 hour' AND "daily_attempts"."retry_available_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("daily_attempts"."status"<>'LOSS' AND "daily_attempts"."retry_available_at" IS NULL)

journal_origin_rng.name: journal_origin_rng
journal_origin_rng.value: ("match_action_journal"."origin"='BOT' AND "match_action_journal"."next_bot_random_state" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("match_action_journal"."next_bot_random_state")='array' AND jsonb_array_length("match_action_journal"."next_bot_random_state")=4) OR ("match_action_journal"."origin" IN ('HUMAN','AUTO') AND "match_action_journal"."next_bot_random_state" IS NULL)

journal_bounds.name: journal_bounds
journal_bounds.value: ("match_action_journal"."first_event_seq" IS NULL AND "match_action_journal"."last_event_seq" IS NULL) OR ("match_action_journal"."first_event_seq" IS NOT NULL AND "match_action_journal"."last_event_seq" IS NOT NULL AND "match_action_journal"."first_event_seq" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND "match_action_journal"."last_event_seq" BETWEEN "match_action_journal"."first_event_seq" AND 9007199254740991)

event_visibility.name: event_visibility
event_visibility.value: ("match_events"."visibility"='OWNER' AND "match_events"."owner_side" IS NOT NULL AND "match_events"."owner_side" IN ('GOOD','EVIL')) OR ("match_events"."visibility" IN ('PUBLIC','SERVER') AND "match_events"."owner_side" IS NULL)

result_numbers.name: result_numbers
result_numbers.value: "match_results"."turns" BETWEEN 0 AND 20 AND "match_results"."active_duration_ms" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "match_results"."damage_dealt" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "match_results"."blocks_used" BETWEEN 0 AND 3

match_numbers.name: match_numbers
match_numbers.value: "matches"."bot_intents_this_turn" BETWEEN 0 AND 64 AND "matches"."revision" >= 0 AND "matches"."revision" <= 9007199254740991 AND "matches"."active_duration_ms" >= 0 AND "matches"."active_duration_ms" <= 9007199254740991

match_tutorial.name: match_tutorial
match_tutorial.value: ("matches"."mode"='TUTORIAL' AND "matches"."scenario_id" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."tutorial_manifest_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."tutorial_manifest_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "matches"."scenario_manifest_sha256" IS NULL) OR ("matches"."mode"='SKIRMISH' AND "matches"."scenario_id" IS NULL AND "matches"."tutorial_manifest_sha256" IS NULL AND "matches"."scenario_manifest_sha256" IS NULL) OR ("matches"."mode"='DAILY_CHALLENGE' AND "matches"."scenario_id" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."tutorial_manifest_sha256" IS NULL AND "matches"."scenario_manifest_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."scenario_manifest_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

principal_kind.name: principal_kind
principal_kind.value: "principals"."kind" IN ('GUEST','ACCOUNT') AND ("principals"."kind" <> 'ACCOUNT' OR "principals"."auth_subject" IS NOT NULL)

principal_merge.name: principal_merge
principal_merge.value: ("principals"."merged_into_principal_id" IS NULL) = ("principals"."merged_at" IS NULL) AND "principals"."merged_into_principal_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "principals"."id"

reward_ledger_check.name: reward_ledger_check
reward_ledger_check.value: ("reward_ledger"."kind" IN ('DAILY','PVE','MILESTONE') AND "reward_ledger"."tickets">0 AND "reward_ledger"."card_id" IS NULL AND "reward_ledger"."cosmetic_key" IS NULL) OR ("reward_ledger"."kind"='CARD' AND "reward_ledger"."tickets"=0 AND "reward_ledger"."card_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reward_ledger"."cosmetic_key" IS NULL) OR ("reward_ledger"."kind"='COSMETIC' AND "reward_ledger"."tickets"=0 AND "reward_ledger"."card_id" IS NULL AND "reward_ledger"."cosmetic_key" IS NOT NULL)
